per_window.ps-ns: unresolved for the free enzyme: no evidence row reports solution order parameters or MD of free WT YkuD, and the search missed the alias LdtBs (YKUD-J2, search_insufficient). The peptidoglycan-bound measurements that reach into ps-ns (bulk REDOR S = 0.82, bulk R1rho) are filed as undetermined because their windows extend to tens of microseconds.
per_window.us-ms: unresolved: the 2012 abstract says relaxation dispersion finds no preexisting exchange in the free apoenzyme, but conditions, residues and window were not readable (YKUD-J1, r1). In the peptidoglycan-bound isolated catalytic domain the authors propose microsecond-to-millisecond exchange among bound and free states without a fit (YKUD-J15, r13).
per_window.slower_than_ms: unresolved (search_insufficient): no CEST, ZZ-exchange, HDX or other slow measurement of the free enzyme (YKUD-J3). The milliseconds-or-longer residence time of full-length LdtBs on peptidoglycan is binding and not counted (YKUD-J11).
per_window.undetermined: Peptidoglycan-bound full-length LdtBs at 298 K, pH 7.2 (solid-state MAS NMR, a separate sample state from the free enzyme) retains bulk motion: H-N dipolar S = 0.82 (YKUD-J9, r7) and bulk 15N R1rho 14 +/- 3 s-1 in a deuterated sample (YKUD-J10, r8), both unlocalized; no freely tumbling or large-amplitude mobile protein is seen by INEPT (YKUD-J11, r9). Not counted: V47C and H122A (YKUD-J12, J13) and isolated LysM (YKUD-J14, binding kinetics). Covalent carbapenem or thiobenzoate modification induces backbone flexibility and noncovalent beta-lactams do not, per abstract only (YKUD-J6 to J8, unresolved). The K117A/Q118A crystal (1Y7M) shows higher B factors in LysM loop entry 25-39 (YKUD-J4, unresolved) and a Cd2+/sulfate crystal artefact at the catalytic Cys142 (YKUD-J5).

protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: Not established: the only us-ms test of free, wild-type apo YkuD is the 2012 relaxation-dispersion study, read as abstract only, which reports no preexisting conformational exchange without giving conditions, residues or detection window (YKUD-J1, unresolved), so no exchanging region, rate or population is known; the residual motion measured by solid-state NMR belongs to the peptidoglycan-bound state.
protein_summary.deposition_readback: Deposition-derived; same numbers RelaxDB labels were computed from; not literature confirmation. BMRB 17701, which the PDB record of the 2012 apo NMR structure 3ZQD cross-references, holds one 600 MHz R1/R2/NOE set at 298 K, pH 6.5, 0.15 M ionic strength for 149 residues (including tag residue H170); NOE below 0.65 marks G1, K3, L4, S35-T41 (overlapping the end of the crystal B-factor loop 25-39), T93, G96, G108, G109, K140 and G168 as fast-moving, and R2/R1 above the 14.25 cut (mean 12.2) flags H60, I61, V63, V86, L90, Q121, Y123 and V138, all between 14.3 and 16.5. The deposited relaxation times appear to be in ms although labelled s, so absolute rates read 1000-fold low and are rounded to four decimals; the R2/R1 ratios and flags do not depend on that unit.
open_conflicts: No same-proposition conflicts. The free apoenzyme (2012 abstract: no preexisting exchange by dispersion) and the peptidoglycan-bound solid (2014: residual bulk motion) are different sample states.
Numbering, not dynamics: the 2006 crystal paper and UniProt O34816 number residues as entry minus 3; the 2014 paper uses entry numbering.
questions_for_gina: Should the 2012 Structure full text and SI be obtained? It is the likely source of the BMRB 17701 relaxation set and of the dispersion null, and without it YKUD-J1 stays unresolved.
Bulk REDOR S and bulk R1rho of the peptidoglycan-bound protein span ps to tens of microseconds; keep them in the undetermined window, or split them between ps-ns and us-ms?
protein_summary.buffer_note: The 2014 solid-state and slurry samples (r7-r13) all use 50 mM HEPES pH 7.2 at 298 K with intact B. subtilis 168 sacculi; the protein is bound to a large, flexible polymer, so these rows describe a peptidoglycan-bound sample state separate from the free solution enzyme, and labelling (deuterated for R1rho, U-13C,15N for 13C detection) differs between experiments. The 2014 SI (Figures S1, S2, S9) was not retrieved, and the 2012 paper was read as abstract only, so no buffer, temperature or field transfers to YKUD-J1 to J3 or J6 to J8. The 1Y7M crystal is a K117A/Q118A surface mutant grown with CdCl2, Li2SO4 and acetate at pH 5.1, and Cd2+/sulfate contacts reshape the active site. Searches used YkuD/ykuD names only, not the alias LdtBs, so absent method classes are search gaps.
